CurrentText: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. Although he was victorious against a Thor, it was noted that the Tomahawk still suffered from numerous system errors and gremlins and was not yet ready for mass production. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064.

CurrentText: The Black Wolf is a thirty-second century, Heavy Class battle 装甲 which was originally created by Clan Scientists from both halves of the divided Wolf Clan. The battle 装甲 began as a joint project between Clan Wolf and Clan Wolf-in-Exile, as part of a means of reunification between the two sundered factions. One of the Black Wolf's deployments would be during the invasion of Tharkad in 3143, where the suit's use would become a symbol of terror for Clan Wolf-in-Exile's allies in the Lyran Commonwealth.

CurrentText: The Inferno heavy OmniMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries of Crofton after New Avalon fell to the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery in the Dark Age. With twenty-nine tons of pod space available and protected by thirteen and a half tons of 装甲, the Inferno became a popular unit in the AFFS. By building on an Endo-Steel chassis with a Compact Gyro engineers were able to free up a lot of space in the traditionally crowded center torso. This freed room for heavy weapons in the most heavily protected part of the 'Mech. In every configuration the main weapons are mounted in the center torso, with additional weaponry in the side torsos (often in over the shoulder mounts), leaving the arms free for physical attacks.

CurrentText: Designed for fast recon and close-quarters combat, the Night Stalker is a medium BattleMech first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. The first original BattleMech produced by Victory Conditions Industries on Mizar, the Night Stalker was first unveiled in the arenas of Solaris VII, where it would gather a reputation that propelled the company’s sales to success. The design would soon see service with the Federated Suns, the Lyran Commonwealth, mercenary units, and among all the nation states of the Inner Sphere.

CurrentText: The Notos is an advanced Heavy-class hybrid between a Quadrupedal OmniMech and 战斗车辆 design, known more simply as a QuadVee, introduced by Clan Hell's Horses. Named after the Greek Goddess of the south wind, the Notos is a more refined QuadVee design in comparison to its earlier predecessors. Retaining the best qualities of the previous models, the machine has been built to support a diverse array of weapon and equipment configurations, while also taking advantage of using wheels in place of tank treads. The Notos can call upon 15 tons worth of equipment allowed by its omnipods. While it sports a modest 12.5 tons of standard 装甲 protection from enemy fire, its true innovation comes with its unique ability: transformation into a 战斗车辆. Powered by a 300-Rated Extra-Light Fusion 引擎, the vehicular Notos can travel at up to a swift 95 km/h, while in 'Mech mode it can move at a solid 80 km/h. This high speed gives it the capability to keep pace with fast combat formations. Unlike its predecessors, the Notos can move significantly faster over flat terrain thanks to its incorporation of wheels rather than tank treads.

CurrentText: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL引擎 allowing it to reach 162 km/h.

CurrentText: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. CurrentText: The Regent was born when Coventry Metal Works, the designers of the Hauptmann, managed to secure construction rights for an updated version of the original design after help by the ilKhanate. The efficiency of Clan technology meant that the Hauptmann could be replicated on a lighter chassis. CurrentText: A prototype OmniMech built on the success of the Stormcrow line, fielded by Clan Wolf for trials before going into full production. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-装甲 interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor 装甲.

Perhaps the most startling innovation included in this design is the Clan Interface Armor, which allows a MechWarrior to interface with their 'Mech while being completely armored should they be forced to eject. This combination interface allows the Ryoken III pilot's a degree of control in combat, and removes the need to have a Gyro mounted in the 'Mech. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-armor interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor Armor.

CurrentText: Needing to build up its forces after establishing the Wolf Empire and wanting a more generalist unit than the Skinwalker, Clan Wolf's Ramiel Bekker created the Stormwolf in collaboration with Clan Sea Fox by modifying the Wendigo to the Clan's exacting specifications. The 'Mech was designed with the intention of striking a balance between firepower and speed, and chief among Bekker's modifications was the addition of fixed mobility-enhancing equipment in order to shape the 'Mech's role in combat, as well as relocating the 'Mech's cockpit to the head. This relocation's associated visual changes gave the 'Mech a more canid or ursid appearance, bringing it more in line with the earlier Wulfen and Warwolf aesthetically.

CurrentText: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. CurrentText: The Tundra Wolf was the first brand new Clan Wolf BattleMech fully developed and solely produced in the Inner Sphere. With losses mounting during the Word of Blake's Jihad, rather than a costly and complex OmniMech, Wolf technicians focused on producing a standard generalist design that could be readily manufactured and fill as many roles within their depleted touman as possible. While somewhat slow for a Clan-made 75-ton 'Mech, the Tundra Wolf made up for that with MASC, that allowed it to sprint in bursts and jump jets, enabling it to leap up to 120 米 at a time.

CurrentText: Named for the symbol of the Egyptian goddess Wadjet, the Uraeus is a heavy BattleMech which first appeared during the Dark Age era in the hands of ComStar and the Republic of the Sphere. With the Malcolm Buhl-led splinter faction the Blessed Order seeking to secretly rebuild the Com Guards, in 3128 agents of the Blessed Order stole advanced Word of Blake technical data, including extensive specs on the Manei Domini's Celestial series OmniMechs, stored within a protected Republic of the Sphere data depot on Terra. Reengineering the secured schematics to develop the Uraeus BattleMech, Buhl commissioned the New Earth Trading Company - little more than a corporate front owned and operated by ComStar since the early Succession Wars - to secretly construct production lines for these new 'Mechs, hiding them among the massive volume of civilian manufacturing lines operated by NETC.

CurrentText: Designed by Defiance Industries, the Storm Raider was intended to be an alternative to the Hollander light 'Mech. Unfortunately for Defiance, the Storm Raider was 50 years too late for the market, and the various prototypes were poorly received - so poorly received, in fact, that Defiance licensed all of the designs to Coventry Metal Works. Coventry Metal Works was manufacturing four different variants of the Storm Raider intended for use in urban defense roles or for small-scale surgical strikes, but the Storm Raider was a poor performer in both roles, outgunned by contemporaries and slower than most. Despite that, the Storm Raider proved an able fighter in the arenas at Solaris VII, where it became a fan favorite.

CurrentText: The Blade is a light-weight scouting and raiding 'Mech that employs its fearsome speed to strike at larger 'Mechs, then to escape before their opponents can track them. Well-suited for pack-hunter and swarming tactics, the Blade works well with other fast units such as the classic Locust and the Clan Dasher. Originally commissioned by the Republic of the Sphere's first Commanding General Victor Steiner-Davion, the Blade was his attempt to standardize and simplify the hodgepodge military hardware as Stone's Coalition became the Republic Armed Forces. The Blade was manufactured from the mid-3080s until around 3096, becoming the signature 'Mechs for Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels, and elite Knights of the Sphere regiments.

CurrentText: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps.

CurrentText: Designed by Adam Tech Industries and manufactured from their plant on Abadan, the Havoc was inspired by the JR7-K Jenner and managed to improve on many of the JR7-K's design features. The combination of almost double the Jenner's 装甲, a 10% increase in speed thanks to the 280 XL引擎 and a weapons loadout that allowed it to battle 'Mechs heavier than itself spurred the Adam Tech advertising campaign, which was geared exclusively towards pilots of light BattleMechs. CurrentText: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. With increasing legal tensions between the newborn Republic and military manufacturers who suffered heavy damage at the hands of Stone's Coalition during Operation SCOUR, Exarch Devlin Stone commissioned a new BattleMech intended to create jobs, bolster his military, and to stave off the worst of the lawsuits. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. Mandating a simple, fast and durable energy weapon design based on the guerrilla-style warfare he conducted in the early years of resistance to the Blakists, Stone was forced to make a number of concessions and include a more expensive Endo Steel chassis along with 铁纤维装甲 装甲, as well as the more fragile Light Fusion 引擎 and XL Gyro in an attempt to win over the military-industrial complex.

CurrentText: Designed by Defiance Industries, the Storm Raider was intended to be an alternative to the Hollander light 'Mech. Unfortunately for Defiance, the Storm Raider was 50 years too late for the market, and the various prototypes were poorly received - so poorly received, in fact, that Defiance licensed all of the designs to Coventry Metal Works. Coventry Metal Works was manufacturing four different variants of the Storm Raider intended for use in urban defense roles or for small-scale surgical strikes, but the Storm Raider was a poor performer in both roles, outgunned by contemporaries and slower than most. Despite that, the Storm Raider proved an able fighter in the arenas at Solaris VII, where it became a fan favorite.

CurrentText: Formerly a Word of Blake design, the Yao Lien is a Capellan Confederation BattleMech based on the Blakists' Celestial series OmniMechs. Initially using captured parts before switching to locally manufactured subcomponents, the rebuilt facility on Capella was turning out the now renamed 'Mech for the Confederation shortly after the recapture of Terra.

CurrentText: The Bakeneko is a medium BattleMech originally created by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat at the dawn of the thirty-second century in a collaboration between Clan Nova Cat scientists and engineers from LAW. Based on the Phoenix Hawk, this slightly bigger design was intended as a fire support and skirmisher unit with the same mobility of the older design. The 'Mech was put into production in early 3100, where it was deployed to both Clan Nova Cat and the DCMS' Eleventh Ghost and Fifth Sword of Light Regiments during the last year of the Second Combine-Dominion War prior to the invasion of Irece in June, 3100. During the invasion, the greatly expanded factories which housed the Bakeneko's production lines were destroyed. The Bakeneko had a reputation as an effective fighting machine, as it was credited numerous kills by Draconis Combine forces during the conflict.

CurrentText: The Aries is a Star Adder assault OmniMech produced on Arcadia, with a possible secondary facility near their invasion corridor. It merges the banned Osteon's design with elements from the Blood Asp, offering 56 tons of pod space - matching the Tomahawk II. Though lacking Ferro-Lamelor 装甲, its durability and adaptability make it a serious threat. Reports indicate up to 16 variants, each capable of engaging at any range with ballistic, missile, and energy loadouts. Some variants show exceptional endurance and heat resistance, staying active under conditions that would disable most 'Mechs. The Aries should be considered a top-tier battlefield threat.

CurrentText: The Italipas, or Chinook as it is known by Clan Coyote, was designed before but produced nearly 30 years after Clan Coyote’s touman was devastated in the Wars of Reaving. Built at the rebuilt Barcella Alpha facility using updated Nova Cat components, production was fast. This 70-ton heavy OmniMech sacrifices speed for firepower and protection, featuring a 280-rated XL引擎 with a supercharger boosting sprint speed from 64 to 86 kph. With 15.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor 装甲 and an Endo Steel skeleton, it offers excellent defense and ample pod space despite its bulk.

CurrentText: The 170 ton Stalker IV superheavy 'Mech, or the SuperStalker as commonly known amongst MechWarriors, is the creation of the best minds at the Republic Institute for Strategic Combat (RISC). CurrentText: The lack of a Clan-made Superheavy QuadMech irked some of the more progressive scientists from the clans that had made it back to the Inner Sphere. So they decided to collaborate in secret on Project Colossus, meant to be the pinnacle of Clan design and ingenuity. The resulting 200 ton Quad OmniMech was eventually renamed to the Arachnid, and was more an ode to the decadence and delusion of grandeur that has started to seep into the Inner Sphere clans than fulfilling any practical role.

CurrentText: The King Dragon is a new addition to the roster of 'Mechs fielded by House Kurita in the Inner Sphere. Developed by the well-known manufacturer, Takara Tomy, this 'Mech was a massive upgrade over the 60-ton Dragon - both considering firepower and survivability. With its imposing size and heavily reinforced 装甲, the King Dragon was designed to fill the role of the ultimate heavy-hitter on the battlefield, a true Dreadnought. Despite its massive size, the King Dragon is surprisingly agile thanks to its highly balance chassis, making it a formidable opponent even for lighter and more nimble 'Mechs. This agility, combined with its advanced targeting systems and unparalleled firepower, makes the King Dragon a fearsome sight on any battlefield. The King Dragon quickly gained a reputation as one of the most fearsome and unstoppable Superheavy BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere and pilots of the 'Mech quickly became legendary figures in the various wars and conflicts that wracked the region, inspiring awe and fear in equal measure. Overall, the King Dragon is a testament to the engineering prowess of Takara Tomy and the relentless pursuit of new and improved designs to bring to the battlefield.

CurrentText: When the news of Precentor Vapula's Celestial series of 'Mechs reached Precentor Destral VII, he refused to have his devotion be outdone. Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and 装甲, such as the Exsecratio Stealth 装甲 and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.

CurrentText: The Menace is one of the heavier Clan Superheavy OmniMechs, weighing in at 185 tons. Based on an Endo Steel chassis with a 350 XL引擎, the chassis is not particularly fast or agile, but it makes up for it with its general offensive package. All configurations of the Menace are heavily focused on offensive firepower at range, often used as a long range option when firepower matters more than survival. To ensure it has enough cooling it uses the volataile Prototype heat sinks, meaning any internal critical hits can turn deadly, but an acceptable risk considering its large offensive arsenal.

The engineer named it after his own homeworld in the Free Worlds League, which I always thought was a nice touch. Heavy 装甲 and real agility made up for the light weapons load in the right hands. When the civil war hit, the factory kept changing hands, and eventually its own side blew it up rather than let the Rim Worlds keep the tech.

CurrentText: A pirate band found one of these drifting in a misjumped dropship, not a soul left alive aboard, just skeletal remains and a strange 'Mech in the cargo bay. Nothing about it matched Star League records they knew. Named it after that old Terran tale on account of the mongoose painted on the shoulder. Sold it to King Grimm for fifty million C-Bills, though it never made it to Oberon. Mysterious white fighters tore the whole convoy apart before they got there.

CurrentText: The SecuriMax stands as proof of just how badly MaxTech wanted a proper BattleMech to its name, though like other SecurityMechs of its era, its industrial roots simply couldn't compete with the real thing. Its heavy rifles and machine guns had little effect against modern 装甲, doing real damage only to similarly outdated equipment or vulnerable infantry. It survived for a time on backwater worlds far from modern militaries, but flawed fire control on its missile systems and overall high cost sealed its fate, making it one of MaxTech's shortest lived designs.

CurrentText: The UrbanMax is cheap and slow, built by MaxTech purely for urban defense without any thought given to crowd control or other non lethal options. It has decent enough firepower to handle most of the threats it's likely to face, but its industrial 装甲 is no match for a real BattleMech. Then Orgus Industries rolled out the UrbanMech and outclassed it in every way, leaving the UrbanMax a cautionary tale in cutting corners.

CurrentText: This thing dates back to 2501, which means it was already ancient when the Star League collapsed. New Earth Trading Company built it, Earthwerks kept producing it, and somehow examples survived all the way to now. The jump jets on an assault mech that size were a big deal when it was new and honestly they still are. Getting one of these out of salvage is finding a piece of history that can still punch a hole through most of what it faces.

That combination is unusual enough on its own, but the Bloodhound Active Probe and Laser AMS together give it a defensive and sensor awareness package you rarely see on a skirmisher this size. It is a reserved-pilot machine, which tells you everything about how the Rangers value it.

The ER PPC gives it genuine reach for a 45-ton machine, and the Sword is a real threat to anything that closes thinking it has an easy target. Not a complicated mech, but it does what it was designed to do without much fuss.

The Shield and Retractable Blade tell you exactly what happens if the taser does not land.

CurrentText: The lack of a Clan-made Superheavy QuadMech irked some of the more progressive scientists from the clans that had made it back to the Inner Sphere. So they decided to collaborate in secret on Project Colossus, meant to be the pinnacle of Clan design and ingenuity. The resulting 200 ton Quad OmniMech was eventually renamed to the Arachnid, and was more an ode to the decadence and delusion of grandeur that has started to seep into the Inner Sphere clans than fulfilling any practical role.

CurrentText: The Arctos is a pure Society design based on the Minsk, and as such is carrying a lot of experimental and cutting edge technology that is still not generally available. Through the use of Ferro-Carbide Shell 装甲 and Endo Titanium 结构 enough weight is saved to enable the Arctos to both be heavily armored and still mount a considerable weaponry with a large damage potential - it even still is somewhat mobile for a superheavy thanks to its large XL引擎. To remaining noticeable features includes an Advanced Torso Cockpit, a head mounted Advanced Laser AMS and prototype double heat sinks.

CurrentText: The 125-ton Hyaenodont OmniMech is a long-range support platform fielded by the Minnesota Tribe and constructed by Twin Forge Assemblies. Built on an Endo-Steel frame and powered by a 355-rated XL引擎, it specializes in providing withering fire support from a distance, often anchoring the rear line of superheavy formations. It is clad in Ferro-Silk 装甲, a fragile yet lightweight steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, allowing for greater weapon mass at the expense of durability, consistent with the Tribe’s doctrine of prioritizing firepower above protection. Its name comes from an ancient Terran apex predator known for its bone-crushing bite and grim persistence, an icon preserved in Clan Wolverine mythos. Revived as a 'Mech by the Tribe, the Hyaenodont reflects their philosophy of overwhelming force and relentless pressure, hammering enemies down until there’s nothing left to resist.

CurrentText: The lack of a Clan-made Superheavy QuadMech irked some of the more progressive scientists from the clans that had made it back to the Inner Sphere. So they decided to collaborate in secret on Project Colossus, meant to be the pinnacle of Clan design and ingenuity. The resulting 200 ton Quad OmniMech was eventually renamed to the Arachnid, and was more an ode to the decadence and delusion of grandeur that has started to seep into the Inner Sphere clans than fulfilling any practical role.

CurrentText: The only superheavy chassis Clan Widowmaker managed to design on their own, the Atrax is a 175 ton beast in the shape of a four-legged spider. Bringing all the strengths of a QuadMech and a Superheavy together, but at the cost of very limited mobility, the 'Mech was never favoured amongst the warriors of the Widowmaker touman, who only begrudgingly piloted the Superheavy. The strangest trait of the chassis are the four LRM-10 launchers that are constructed as a permanent part of the chassis, one in each knee.

CurrentText: When the news of Precentor Vapula's Celestial series of 'Mechs reached Precentor Destral VII, he refused to have his devotion be outdone. Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and 装甲, such as the Exsecratio Stealth 装甲 and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.

CandidateChinese: 当瓦普拉军事主教的天体系列机甲传到德斯特拉尔七世军事主教耳中时，他拒绝让自己的信仰被比下去。他把一切可用和不可用的资源都投入其中，设计团队最终打造出 Leliorium——一台重 200 吨的全能机甲。它的名字取自《所罗门之钥》中地位最高的恶魔，对应天体系列的天使。为了进一步说明这些并非单纯强化版天体机甲，每种配置都以九位恶魔之王中的一位命名。每台机甲都使用 Exsecratio 隐形装甲、Seraphim 电子战套件等最前沿的实验武器与装甲。每台机甲出厂前的最后一道检查，是由六名高级布莱克牧师进行神圣祝福，确保驾驶员和机甲都受到布莱克庇佑。

CurrentText: The Malice appears to be on its way towards becoming one of the premier mercenary assault 'Mechs of the age. Seen most often in the Galatean Defense Force and the Republic Armed Forces, the Malice has seen a lot of action for such a recent addition to the battlefield. Very fast for an assault 'Mech, topping out around 64 km/h, this brute can bring a withering barrage of autocannon fire to bear. Protected by more than nineteen tons of standard 装甲, the Malice can remain in combat for a long time.

CurrentText: The Manx is a ComStar design for an heavy impact superheavy based around Rotary Autocannons of various sizes and types. At 170 ton and using all the weight saving technology there is, an impressive amount of weapons can be fit on the chassis. The arm and shoulder actuators are strengthened to allow for reduction of the weapon recoil. Even the sensor and piloting equipment are top notch, the combination of Vehicular DNI, Angel ECM, Bloodhound Probe and a C3i unit making it near impossible to not perform well with the 'Mech on the battlefield.

CurrentText: As more and more Superheavy 'Mechs started appearing with the Inner Sphere and Clan armies, a rising demand for them was created within the periphery states as well. With their limited resources and more mundane needs, Earthwerks Limited saw an opportunity to create a cheap, simple design that still could take a beating. The choice was to create the 190 ton Thunderstone, trying to use the good reputation of the Thunderbolt as a launch platform it was designed with very similar looks. The high tonnage might at first seem to go against the cheap and simple concept, but it allows Earthwerks Limited to use less optimized components, which in turn allows the customers to do their own repair and maintenance at lower costs. The design comes with a 350 rated 引擎 core, double heat sinks and an AMS by default.

CurrentText: As more and more Superheavy 'Mechs started appearing with the Inner Sphere and Clan armies, a rising demand for them was created within the periphery states as well. With their limited resources and more mundane needs, Earthwerks Limited saw an opportunity to create a cheap, simple design that still could take a beating. The choice was to create the 190 ton Thunderstone, trying to use the good reputation of the Thunderbolt as a launch platform it was designed with very similar looks. The high tonnage might at first seem to go against the cheap and simple concept, but it allows Earthwerks Limited to use less optimized components, which in turn allows the customers to do their own repair and maintenance at lower costs. The design comes with a 350 rated 引擎 core, double heat sinks and an AMS by default.
